scenario.name: Dispute Defense (Chargeback Automation)
scenario.description: Client files chargeback → Pull evidence from Airtable → Use OpenAI to generate defense → Auto-submit to Stripe

modules.name: Stripe Webhook - Dispute Created
modules.description: Triggers when a dispute/chargeback is filed

modules.name: Airtable - Get All Business Policies
modules.description: Retrieves all active policies for evidence

modules.name: Airtable - Create Dispute Record
modules.description: Creates tracking record for the dispute

modules.name: Text Aggregator - Compile Evidence
modules.description: Compiles all evidence into a single document

modules.name: OpenAI - Generate Defense Letter
modules.description: Uses GPT-4 to generate professional dispute response

messages.content:
You are a professional dispute resolution specialist helping beauty businesses defend against chargebacks. Write a formal, evidence-based response to Stripe disputes that:

1. Remains professional and factual
2. Cites specific policies the customer agreed to
3. References payment records and timestamps
4. Explains the service provided or reason for charge
5. Demonstrates good-faith business practices
6. Requests the dispute be decided in the merchant's favor

Keep responses under 1000 characters for Stripe's evidence field. Do not be accusatory toward the customer - focus on facts.

modules.name: Airtable - Save AI Evidence to Dispute
modules.description: Stores compiled evidence and AI response

modules.name: Airtable - Get Cancellation Policy Text
modules.description: Gets cancellation policy for Stripe evidence

modules.name: Stripe - Submit Evidence
modules.description: Submits evidence directly to Stripe dispute

body.evidence[cancellation_policy_disclosure]: Policy was displayed on booking form and included in confirmation email sent on {{formatDate(2.records[0].fields['Deposit Paid Date'], 'MMMM D, YYYY')}}

modules.name: Airtable - Mark Auto-Submitted
modules.description: Updates dispute record with submission status

modules.name: Gmail - Notify Business Owner
modules.description: Alerts business owner about chargeback and defense

config.subject: ⚠️ Chargeback Filed - Auto-Defense Submitted

errorHandling.note: Disputes are time-sensitive - manual review needed if automation fails

testChecklist: Create test dispute in Stripe (use test mode)
Verify dispute record created in Airtable
Verify evidence compilation includes all relevant data
Review AI-generated defense for accuracy and professionalism
Verify business owner notification email sent
Check all timestamps and IDs are correctly populated
notes: This automation significantly improves chargeback win rates by responding within minutes instead of days
The AI prompt is designed to be professional and fact-based, never accusatory
All evidence is sourced directly from Airtable records for accuracy
Manual review is still recommended for complex disputes
